name: Plain text
summary: The agent replies with Markdown text in a thread, with no custom components. It works almost everywhere, from web chat to Slack, Teams and Telegram, and many channels now render richer Markdown and streamed text natively.
how: Have the model answer in Markdown
Stream or post the text into the conversation thread
Convert Markdown to each channel's formatting rules
Use links or attachments for anything that does not fit in text
facts: Slack streaming APIs, Teams extended Markdown, Telegram rich messages
Portable and simple, but no interactive controls
goodFor: Agents that run on many channels
watchOut: Long tables and code blocks can render poorly on mobile
